description: This file defines API endpoints related to meal planning using FastAPI. It includes a router with a GET endpoint '/generate' that calls an external spoonacular API client to generate meal plans based on specified query parameters.

methods.name: generate_meal_plan( time_frame: str = Query("day", pattern="^(day|week)$", description="Timeframe to generate meal plan for: day or week"), target_calories: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=800, le=5000, description="Target daily calories"), diet: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Dietary preference (e.g., vegetarian, keto)"), exclude: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Comma-separated ingredients to exclude"), client=Depends(get_spoonacular_client), )
methods.description: An asynchronous function that generates a meal plan based on query parameters by calling the spoonacular client and handles potential errors.
